main_text.p: Perdere: item Addere, Adjicere, quod à יסף mutuatur. Niphal נִסְפָּה Consumi. Hiphil הִסְפָּה Addidit, Accumulavit.

סָפַח Aggregavit, Adhærere fecit, Adhibuit, Adjunxit. Niphal נִסְפַּח Adjungere vel Associare se. Pihel שִׂפַּח Adhibere, Admovere: Scabie afficere, vel Decalvare, Jesa.3.17. Pyhal Futurum, יְסֻפְּחוּ Aggregabuntur, vel Scabie aut abscessibus afficientur, Job.30.7. Hithpahel Infin. Ne adhæream, 1.Sam.26.19.
סְפִיחַ m. Sponte nascens vel crescens, sine semente aut satione: plur. סְפִיחִים.
מִסְפַּחַת סְפַחַת f. Scabies, Abscessus, Apostema.
מִסְפָּחוֹת f. p. Confibulæ: Pepla, Tiara.
סָפַן Texit, Obtexit. Quandoq; est cum ש.
סְפִינָה f. Navis propriè magna & tecta.
סַף סַפָּה m. Limen: Pelvis,plur. סִפּוֹת סִפּוֹת, Pelves.
הִסְתַּסְּפֵל Hithpahel Ad limen manere, Limen transfire vel frequentare.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words are given as best read; the Hebrew vowel points and dots in the scan are partly illegible and may differ from the printed forms. The running head "ꝏ" is a Hebrew-letter ornament and uncertain.
